messages:
Incidents Bot: ALERT -> SLO breach detected for /v1/stream (streaming) p99 = 2.3s (> SLO 1.0s). Error spike: TLS handshake failures + long tail stalls. Regions: eu-west2 and us-west1. Paging oncall.
Oncall Pager: paging Elena, Raj. Escalation level: P1. Runbook: streaming-latency.
Elena: acked — looking now. tagging @Raj and @Sam. Anyone seeing config changes in routing or egress in the last hour?
Sam: I saw a deploy to egress-router pool ~40m ago but nothing directly touching NAT config. Checking metrics now: outbound SNAT port exhaustion alarms firing on gw-eu-2a and gw-eu-2b. 
Marta: seeing elevated retransmits on streaming gateways and a spike in TCP SYN retries. Also DNS rtt up ~300ms in eu-west2. Looks like clients get multiple SYNs then stalls.
Raj: quick network summary: we pushed a BGP path preference tweak 45m ago to shift some traffic to a new AZ-local egress path. It should be safe but I can revert if required. Could be asymmetric path + SNAT churn.
Elena: if SNAT ports are depleted, new connections will stall until ephemeral ports free up. That matches TLS handshake timeouts and streaming sessions stalling. Confirmed p95 also creeping up.
Sam: past 10m netstat snippet from gw-eu-2a (high connection churn):
```
$ ss -tan sport = :443 | wc -l
> 18200
$ cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range
32768 60999
```
We're around 18k concurrent ephemeral mappings on that node.
Marta: also saw NAT conntrack table growth and `nf_conntrack` drops in dmesg on gw-eu-2b.
David: customer update: a handful of streaming customers reported stalls and reconnections starting ~22:10 UTC. No data leak, just session interruptions. High priority customers: streamer-inc, dialogly. They're on dedicated pools in eu-west.
Elena: immediate mitigations: 1) move a subset of traffic to standby egress pool in eu-west2; 2) temporarily bump ip_local_port_range on affected hosts; 3) roll back the BGP tweak if it doesn't stabilize.
Raj: prepping a routing rollback now. Will revert the path preference for egress-nexthop set A -> old behavior. ETA 2m. @Sam please hold off scaling anything that rebalances connections until rollback finishes.
Sam: started port-range bump via remote exec on gw-eu-* (one-off) — increasing to `1024 65535` on test host, then will push cluster-wide if stable.
Deploy Bot: ran command `ssh gw-eu-2a sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range="1024 65535"` -> OK. Applied to gw-eu-2a, gw-eu-2b staged.
Marta: added short iptables conntrack helper tweak to reduce TIME_WAIT dwell for ephemeral sockets on the hosts (temp). Will post config after rollback results.
Incidents Bot: Incident page created: https://incidents.redwood/status/INC-2026-0321-01. Tags: latency, nat, tls-handshake, streaming.
Elena: routing rollback complete. Raj: confirm? 
Raj: rollback applied across eu-west2. BGP path preferences restored to previous values at 22:15:40 UTC.
Sam: after rollback, connection churn down on gw-eu-2a: concurrent ephemeral mappings now ~9.4k. SYN retries decreased. P99 for streaming dropped from 2.3s -> 0.9s in last 2m.
Marta: DNS RTOs also falling. Looks like reduced packet loss on egress path. Early signs mitigation working.
David: notifying impacted customers: sending short heads-up to streamer-inc and dialogly with ETA for full postmortem.
Elena: keeping incident open for monitoring 30m. Next steps: - increase ephemeral port ranges permanently on egress fleet - add control-plane guardrail to prevent path-preference pushes without canary - add netflow telemetry for SNAT churn detection - evaluate connection pooling improvements in serving runtime.
Raj: will open config rollback playbook and add safety check to BGP workflows. 
Sam: will file a followup change to increase ephemeral pool on staging and prod egress images. Also will add conntrack metrics to dashboard.
Deploy Bot: POST deploy log -> runbooks/egress-port-range-change applied to gw-eu-* by Sam at 22:17:05 UTC.
Incidents Bot: SLO status update: p95 = 480ms, p99 = 950ms (target 1000ms), streaming error rate trending down. Keep monitoring.
Marta: note for RCA: asymmetric route + SNAT port churn amplified by a recent BGP tweak -> triggers TLS handshake retries which blow up perceived tail latency for streaming sessions.
Elena: agreed. We'll do a 1hr RCA meeting 23:30 UTC and publish a short postmortem by EOD. Marking as monitoring. :white_check_mark:
Raj: thanks all. I'll follow up on the playbook PR.
David: thanks team — customer comms queued.
Oncall Pager: incident status -> MONITORING. Paging cleared.
Incidents Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE -> mitigation applied, monitoring.
